fold.norm: all RMSNorm affine weights fused into consumer weights then set to one

fold.r3: QuaRot cross-head Hadamard at o_proj for Hadamard rows; omitted for the specified NAR R1/R2/R4 rows
fold.r4: per-layer down-input rotation folded into down_proj rows
